text: EX-10.3 3 tm2629135d1_ex10-3.htm EXHIBIT 10.3 Exhibit 10.3 SECOND AMENDMENT TO ASSET PURCHASE AGREEMENT THIS SECOND AMENDMENT TO ASSET PURCHASE AGREEMENT (the “ Second Amendment ”) is made as of November 5, 2026 (the “ Second Amendment Effective Date ”), by and among EveryLife Inc., a Delaware corporation, and EveryLife Women, LLC, a Florida limited liability company (together, jointly and severally, “ Seller ”), and FreeHold Brands, LLC, a Wyoming limited liability company (“ Buyer ”). WITNESSETH THAT: WHEREAS , Seller and Buyer executed and entered into that certain Asset Purchase Agreement, dated July 28, 2026 (the “ Original Agreement ”), for the sale and purchase of substantially all assets in Seller’s business; WHEREAS , Seller and Buyer executed and entered into that certain First Amendment to Asset Purchase Agreement, dated as of September 15, 2026 (the “ First Amendment ” and, together with the Original Agreement, the “ Agreement ”), pursuant to which the Outside Date, as defined in the Agreement, was extended from September 26, 2026 to October 26, 2026; and WHEREAS , Seller and Buyer desire to further amend the Agreement, as set forth in this Second Amendment, to (1) further extend the Outside Date, (2) revise the manner in which the Purchase Price is paid, such that a portion of the Purchase Price is paid in cash at the Closing and the remaining balance is paid pursuant to a seller-financed promissory note, and (3) provide for a mutual release of certain claims under the Agreement. NOW THEREFORE , for good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, Seller and Buyer agree as follows: 1. Extension of Outside Date . The “Outside Date” as defined in Section 8.1(c) of the Agreement, as previously extended by the First Amendment, is hereby further extended from October 26, 2026 to November 5, 2026. 2. Payment of Purchase Price . Section 2.4 of the Agreement is hereby amended by adding the following new Section 2.4(c) : “ Payment of Purchase Price . The Adjusted Purchase Price shall be paid by Buyer to Seller as follows: (i) at the Closing, One Million Dollars ($1,000,000) in cash by wire transfer of immediately available funds in accordance with Section 2.5 (the “ Closing Cash Payment ”); and (ii) the remaining balance of the Purchase Price, being Four Million Five Hundred Thousand Dollars ($4,500,000), as reduced by any reduction to the Purchase Price pursuant to Section 2.4(b) (the “ Seller Note Amount ”), by delivery at the Closing of a promissory note made by Buyer payable to Seller in an original principal amount equal to the Seller Note Amount (the “ Seller Note ”).” The form of Seller Note is attached hereto as Exhibit E . 1 3. Conforming Amendments . (a) The last sentence of Section 2.4(b) of the Agreement is hereby amended and restated in its entirety to read as follows: “Any reduction to the Purchase Price pursuant to this Section 2.4(b) shall be reflected as a reduction to the original principal amount of the Seller Note and not as a reduction to the Closing Cash Payment.” (b) Section 2.5 of the Agreement is hereby amended by deleting the words “the Adjusted Purchase Price” at the end of clause (b) thereof and replacing them with “the Closing Cash Payment”. (c) Section 2.7(a) of the Agreement is hereby amended and restated in its entirety to read as follows: “(a) The Closing Cash Payment by wire transfer to an account specified by Seller in writing delivered to Buyer at least three (3) business days prior to the Closing Date;”. (d) Section 2.7 of the Agreement is hereby further amended by adding the following new Section 2.7(f) : “(f) The Seller Note, duly executed by Buyer.” (e) For purposes of Section 7.6(d)(iv) of the Agreement, the Purchase Price “actually paid or delivered to Seller” shall include the Closing Cash Payment and the original principal amount of the Seller Note, it being agreed that delivery of the Seller Note at the Closing constitutes delivery of such portion of the Purchase Price. (f) The form of Seller Note attached to this Second Amendment as Exhibit E is hereby added to the Agreement as Exhibit E thereto. (g) Section 4.1(c) of the Agreement is hereby amended by inserting, immediately before the period at the end of the first sentence thereof, the words “, other than any permit, consent, waiver, approval or authorization that has been obtained on or prior to the Closing Date”. The foregoing amendment shall be effective as of the date of the Original Agreement . 4. Deletion of Financing Condition; Buyer Funds . (a) Section 6.1(e) of the Agreement is hereby deleted in its entirety and replaced with “(e) [Reserved].” (b) Section 4.5 of the Agreement is hereby amended and restated in its entirety to read as follows: “ Sufficiency of Funds; Solvency . (a) Buyer has, and at the Closing will have, sufficient cash on hand or other sources of immediately available funds to (i) pay the Closing Cash Payment, (ii) pay all fees and expenses to be paid by Buyer in connection with the transactions contemplated by this Agreement, and (iii) satisfy all other payment obligations of Buyer at the Closing. 2 (b) Immediately after giving effect to the Closing, including the issuance of the Seller Note, Buyer will be solvent and able to pay its debts as they become due. (c) Buyer’s obligation to consummate the Closing is not subject to any condition regarding Buyer’s or any other Person’s ability to obtain financing; provided, however, that nothing in this Agreement shall limit any right of Buyer under the Seller Note, including any right to extend the maturity of the Seller Note. (d) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, the representations and warranties in this Section 4.5 are made solely as of the effective date of the Second Amendment to this Agreement and as of the Closing Date.” (c) Section 6.2(a) of the Agreement is hereby amended by replacing the reference to “ Sections 4.1 , 4.2 , 4.3 , and 4.4 ” with “ Sections 4.1 , 4.2 , 4.3 , 4.4 , and 4.5 ”. For the avoidance of doubt, the foregoing amendment applies solely for purposes of Section 6.2(a) and shall not modify the references to Sections 4.1 , 4.2 , 4.3 , and 4.4 in Section 7.6(d)(ii) or Section 7.6(e) of the Agreement. (d) Buyer Right of Setoff . ARTICLE 7 of the Agreement is hereby amended by adding the following new Section 7.10 : “ Right of Setoff . Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, the Seller Note or any Related Agreement, Buyer may set off against any amount payable under the Seller Note (a) any amount owed to any Buyer Indemnified Person under this ARTICLE 7 or otherwise under this Agreement that has been agreed by Seller, has not been disputed by Seller in accordance with Section 7.3 , or has been finally determined by a final, non-appealable Order, (b) subject to the requirements and limitations of Section 4 of the Seller Note, the amount of any claim set forth in a Notice of Claim delivered in good faith, pending final resolution of such claim, and (c) any amount that Buyer is entitled to set off under Section 5(f) of the Transition Services Agreement; provided that Buyer shall pay to the holder of the Seller Note any amount withheld under clause (b) that is finally determined not to be owed, together with interest at the rate then applicable under the Seller Note, within ten (10) Business Days after such final determination. Any amount set off under clause (a) or clause (c) shall be treated as a payment under the Seller Note to the extent of the amount set off, any amount withheld under clause (b) shall be treated as a payment under the Seller Note only when finally determined to be owed (and then as of the date withheld), and no setoff or withholding made in accordance with this Section 7.10 and Section 4 of the Seller Note shall constitute a default or event of default under the Seller Note. The rights of Buyer under this Section 7.10 shall be binding upon any holder, successor or assignee of the Seller Note.” 3 5. Mutual Release . Effective as of the Second Amendment Effective Date, each of Seller and Buyer, for itself and its Affiliates, successors and assigns, hereby irrevocably releases and forever discharges the other Party and its Affiliates, and their respective directors, officers, managers, members, employees, agents and representatives, from any and all claims, demands, actions, causes of action, Liabilities and Losses, whether known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the Agreement or the negotiation, performance or non-performance thereof, in each case to the extent arising from facts, events or circumstances occurring on or prior to the Second Amendment Effective Date, including any claim arising from or relating to (a) Buyer’s efforts to obtain, or failure to obtain, debt financing, including under Section 4.5 or Section 6.1(e) of the Agreement as in effect prior to the Second Amendment Effective Date, or (b) the failure of the Closing to occur on or prior to any prior Outside Date; provided, however, that nothing in this Section shall release (i) any obligation of either Party under the Agreement as amended by this Second Amendment, the Seller Note or any other Related Agreement to be performed after the Second Amendment Effective Date, (ii) any representation or warranty set forth in the Agreement (as amended hereby) or any right to indemnification under ARTICLE 7 of the Agreement in respect thereof, other than with respect to the matters described in clauses (a) and (b) above, or (iii) any claim arising from Fraud. Section 9.16(c) of the Agreement shall apply to this release mutatis mutandis . This Section shall survive any termination of the Agreement. 6. Guarantor Reaffirmation . Concurrently with the execution of this Second Amendment, Seller shall cause Guarantor to execute and deliver to Buyer a reaffirmation of the Guaranty in the form attached hereto as Exhibit F (the “ Guarantor Reaffirmation ”). This Second Amendment shall not be effective until the Guarantor Reaffirmation has been executed and delivered to Buyer. 7. Capitalized Terms . Except to the extent defined to the contrary herein, all capitalized terms used in this Second Amendment shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Agreement. 8. Full Force and Effect . Other than to the extent expressly modified and amended by this Second Amendment, Seller and Buyer ratify the Agreement and acknowledge that it shall remain in full force and effect in accordance with its terms. The provisions of this Second Amendment, to the extent inconsistent with any other provision of the Agreement, shall prevail. 9. Counterparts . Any number of counterparts of this Second Amendment may be signed and delivered, each of which shall be considered an original and all of which, together, shall constitute one and the same instrument. For purposes of this Second Amendment, a signature delivered by electronic means shall be as binding upon the delivering party as an original signature. 10. Governing Law . This Second Amendment shall be construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware without giving effect to any conflicts of law rules thereof that would direct the application of the law of any other jurisdiction. [Signatures on the following page.] 4 IN WITNESS WHEREOF , Seller and Buyer have caused their duly authorized representatives to execute, seal and deliver this Second Amendment, all as of the first date written above. text: EX-10.4 4 tm2629135d1_ex10-4.htm EXHIBIT 10.4 Exhibit 10.4 NON-NEGOTIABLE SECURED PROMISSORY NOTE Principal Amount: Henrico, Virginia $4,500,000.00 November 5, 2026 FOR VALUE RECEIVED, the undersigned, FreeHold Brands, LLC , a Wyoming limited liability company (the “ Maker ”), having an address of 4100 E. Parham Rd, Ste D, Henrico, Virginia 23228, hereby promises to pay to Noteholder the principal amount of Four Million Five Hundred Thousand and 00/100 Dollars ($4,500,000.00) (the “ Principal ”), together with interest and other amounts payable in accordance with this Note. The Noteholder is EveryLife Inc., a Delaware corporation, and EveryLife Women, LLC, a Florida limited liability company (together, jointly and severally, “ Noteholder ”), c/o PSQ Holdings, Inc., 515 W Aspen Street, Suite 200C, Bozeman, Montana 59715. All payments under this Note shall be made by wire transfer to the account designated in writing by Noteholder on or before the date of this Note (the “ Payment Account ”), and any payment made to the Payment Account shall fully discharge Maker’s obligation with respect to such payment as to each Person comprising Noteholder. The Payment Account may be changed only by written notice signed by each Person comprising Noteholder (or following a Permitted Transfer, by the Permitted Transferee, alone) or as otherwise provided in Section 10 and delivered at least ten (10) Business Days before the applicable payment date. This Note is the Seller Note delivered under that certain Asset Purchase Agreement dated July 28, 2026, as amended by the First Amendment dated September 15, 2026, and the Second Amendment dated November 5, 2026 (as amended, the “ Purchase Agreement ”). Capitalized terms used but not defined herein shall have the meanings ascribed to them in the Purchase Agreement. 1. Principal and Interest Payments and Late Fees . The outstanding and unpaid Principal balance of this Note, and any accrued and unpaid interest thereon (the “ Interest ”), shall be paid as follows: (a) No Interest shall accrue during the first three (3) months after the date of this Note (the “ Interest-Free Period ”). For the avoidance of doubt, if the Note is executed on any date in November 2026, the Interest-Free Period shall end on February 1, 2027, and interest shall begin to accrue as of that date as described herein. Beginning on the first day of the calendar month after the Interest-Free Period, the outstanding Principal shall bear simple interest at the Prime Rate, without any margin or spread. “ Prime Rate ” means the prime rate published in the “Money Rates” section of The Wall Street Journal, determined on the first day of the calendar month following the Interest-Free Period and adjusted on the first day of each calendar quarter thereafter. Interest shall be calculated on the basis of a 365-day year for the actual number of days elapsed. (b) Maker shall make monthly installments of principal in the amount of $83,333.33 on the first day of each month, beginning December 1, 2026 and continuing through the Maturity Date, subject to the final payment of all remaining Principal and accrued Interest on the Maturity Date. Accrued Interest shall be payable monthly in arrears with each principal installment falling due after the Interest-Free Period. 1 (c) The “ Maturity Date ” shall be the first anniversary of the date of this Note. On the Maturity Date, all remaining Principal, together with all accrued and unpaid Interest and other amounts then due under this Note, shall be immediately due and payable in full. (d) Provided that no Event of Default under this Note shall have occurred, Maker shall have two (2) successive options to extend the Maturity Date for an additional twelve (12) months each. Maker may exercise each option by written notice delivered to Noteholder at least fifteen (15) days before the then-current Maturity Date certifying that Maker, despite commercially reasonable efforts (which such notice shall describe with reasonable particularity), has not obtained bank financing sufficient to repay this Note, which certification shall be conclusive and binding on Noteholder. Upon each such exercise, the Maturity Date shall be extended accordingly, and all references in this Note to the Maturity Date shall mean the Maturity Date as so extended. During each extension period, the monthly principal installments of $83,333.33 and accrued Interest shall continue to be payable as provided herein, and all remaining Principal and accrued Interest shall be due on the Maturity Date as so extended. (e) Whenever any payment hereunder is due on a day that is not a Business Day, such payment shall be made on the next succeeding Business Day. For purposes of this Note, “ Business Day ” means any day other than Saturday, Sunday, or a legal holiday or other day on which banks in Richmond, Virginia are authorized or required by law to close. No late fee or other late charge shall apply. (f) Payments shall be applied first to accrued and unpaid Interest and then to Principal, and no fees, costs, or expenses shall be applied before Interest. 2. Prepayment . Maker may prepay this Note in whole or in part at any time and from time to time without premium or penalty. Any partial prepayment shall be applied first to accrued and unpaid Interest and then to Principal, and the Principal portion shall be applied, at Maker’s election specified in writing at the time of such prepayment, to the next scheduled monthly principal installments in direct order of maturity or to the remaining installments in inverse order of maturity. If Maker makes no election, the prepayment shall be applied to the next scheduled monthly principal installments in direct order of maturity. 2 3. Security . This Note is secured by that certain Security Agreement of even date herewith by and between Maker and Noteholder (the “ Security Agreement ”). The Security Agreement covers only the Purchased Assets (as defined in the Purchase Agreement) and the proceeds thereof (collectively, the “ Collateral ”), and not all of Maker’s business assets. Maker authorizes filings and other actions only to create, perfect, protect, or enforce Noteholder’s security interest in the Collateral. Noteholder’s lien and payment rights are subordinate to the rights and liens of each Senior Lender. “ Senior Lender ” means (i) United Bank and its successors and assigns, as lender to MerryGoRound, Inc., a Virginia corporation and the sole member of Maker (“ Parent ”), under that certain Credit Agreement dated June 30, 2025, as amended, restated, supplemented, refinanced or replaced from time to time, and (ii) any other bank or institutional lender providing financing to Maker or Parent, in each case including with respect to any guaranty by Maker of, or any lien granted by Maker to secure, such financing. Maker may, without the consent of Noteholder, (A) guarantee any obligations owed to any Senior Lender, (B) grant liens on any or all of its assets, including the Collateral, to any Senior Lender, and (C) permit Parent to pledge its equity interests in Maker to any Senior Lender, and none of the foregoing, nor any exercise of rights or remedies by any Senior Lender, shall constitute a breach of this Note or the Security Agreement or an Event of Default. The liens of each Senior Lender on the Collateral shall be senior to Noteholder’s lien, regardless of the time, order or method of attachment or perfection of any such lien, the time or order of filing of any financing statement, or the date on which any such lien is granted. Noteholder shall execute and deliver, within ten (10) Business Days after request, a subordination or intercreditor agreement in the form reasonably requested by the applicable Senior Lender. Recourse for this Note is solely against Maker and the Collateral. No member, manager, officer, affiliate, or other person has any liability, and no personal guaranty is given or required. 4. Setoff . Maker may set off against any amount payable under this Note (a) any amount owed to Maker or any Buyer Indemnified Person under Article 7 of the Purchase Agreement or otherwise under the Purchase Agreement that has been agreed by Seller, has not been disputed by Seller in accordance with Section 7.3 of the Purchase Agreement, or has been finally determined by a final, non-appealable Order, (b) the amount of any claim set forth in a Notice of Claim delivered in good faith, pending final resolution of such claim, and (c) any amount that Maker is entitled to set off under Section 5(f) of the Transition Services Agreement; provided that, with respect to any withholding under clause (b): (i) each Notice of Claim on which any withholding under this clause (b) is based shall be delivered to Noteholder concurrently with its delivery to Seller and shall specify in reasonable detail the facts constituting the basis for such claim, the provisions of the Purchase Agreement under which such claim is asserted, and the amount of such claim (or, if such amount is not then known, Maker’s good-faith estimate thereof); (ii) any withholding under this clause (b) shall be subject to the limitations set forth in Article 7 of the Purchase Agreement; and (iii) Maker shall pay to Noteholder any amount so withheld that is finally determined not to be owed, together with interest at the rate then applicable under this Note, within ten (10) Business Days after such final determination, in each case upon written notice to Noteholder. Any amount set off under clause (a) or clause (c) shall be treated as a payment under this Note to the extent of the amount set off as of the date set off. Any amount withheld under clause (b) shall not be treated as a payment under this Note unless and until finally determined to be owed, at which time it shall be treated as set off as of the date withheld. No setoff or withholding made in compliance with this Section 4 shall constitute a default or an Event of Default, and any setoff or withholding not made in compliance with this Section 4 shall constitute a failure to make a payment when due for purposes of Section 5(a). Any amount set off shall be applied to Principal, at Maker’s election specified in such notice, to the next scheduled monthly principal installments in direct order of maturity or to the remaining installments in inverse order of maturity. The rights of Maker under this Section 4 are in addition to, and shall be construed consistently with, Section 7.10 of the Purchase Agreement and Section 5(f) of the Transition Services Agreement, and shall be binding upon any holder, successor or assignee of this Note. 3 5. Events of Default . Each of the following shall constitute an “ Event of Default ” hereunder, subject to the applicable notice and cure periods below: (a) Maker fails to make any payment under this Note when due and such failure continues for ten (10) days after written notice from Noteholder to Maker of such failure; (b) Maker institutes a voluntary case, proceeding or other action seeking relief under any law relating to bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, or other relief for debtors, or seeking appointment of a receiver, trustee, custodian, or other similar official for Maker or for all or any substantial part of Maker’s assets; (c) An involuntary case, proceeding, or other action is commenced seeking the liquidation or reorganization of Maker under any law relating to bankruptcy or insolvency, and such case is not dismissed or vacated within ninety (90) days after its filing; (d) Maker makes a general assignment for the benefit of its creditors; (e) Maker breaches or defaults under any representation, warranty, covenant, or agreement contained in this Note or the Security Agreement, and such breach or default continues for thirty (30) days after written notice thereof from Noteholder to Maker; provided, however, that if such breach or default is not reasonably capable of being cured within such thirty (30) day period, Maker shall have an additional period not to exceed thirty (30) days after receipt of such notice to cure such breach or default, so long as Maker promptly commences and diligently pursues such cure; (f) Maker dissolves, liquidates, or winds up, or commences any proceeding or files any document to do so, or ceases to conduct the Business for more than ten (10) consecutive Business Days; (g) Any certification, representation, warranty, or statement made or delivered by Maker in or pursuant to this Note, the Security Agreement, or any other document delivered by Maker to Noteholder in connection herewith or therewith is false or misleading in any material respect when made or delivered; and (h) This Note or the Security Agreement ceases to be in full force and effect, or the Security Agreement ceases to create a valid and perfected security interest in the Collateral with the priority contemplated by Section 3, in each case other than as a result of payment in full, any act or omission of Noteholder, or the grant of any lien to, or any exercise of rights or remedies by, any Senior Lender as permitted by Section 3. 4 6. Acceleration . Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, and only after expiration of the applicable notice and cure period, Noteholder may elect, by written notice to Maker, to declare the entire unpaid Principal and accrued Interest immediately due and payable. No acceleration shall be effective before delivery of that written notice, except that all amounts shall become immediately due and payable automatically upon the commencement of a voluntary bankruptcy case by Maker or the entry of an order for relief in an involuntary bankruptcy case. 7. Remedies . Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, after expiration of the applicable notice and cure period and upon written notice to Maker, Noteholder may avail itself of the legal or equitable rights and remedies available under this Note, the Security Agreement, and applicable law, all of which shall be cumulative. Interest shall accrue only on overdue amounts, from the date specified in the notice after expiration of the applicable cure period, at a default rate equal to the Prime Rate plus two percent (2.00%) (the “ Default Rate ”), and the Default Rate shall cease upon cure of the applicable default. 8. Enforcement Costs . Each party shall bear its own costs and expenses in connection with this Note, except that the prevailing party in a final adjudication of an action to enforce this Note or the Security Agreement shall be entitled to recover its reasonable attorneys’ fees and court costs from the non-prevailing party. 9. No Waiver . Neither any course of dealing by either party, nor any failure or delay by either party to exercise any rights, powers, or privileges hereunder, shall operate as a waiver of any such rights or remedies unless the waiver is in writing and signed by the party granting it, and then only to the extent specifically set forth in that writing. A waiver as to one event shall not be construed as a continuing waiver as to any subsequent event, and no single or partial exercise of any right or remedy shall preclude any other or further exercise thereof. 5 10. Assignment . This Note is non-negotiable. Noteholder may not sell, assign, pledge, hypothecate, participate, or otherwise transfer this Note or any payment right under it, whether voluntarily, by merger, consolidation, dissolution, liquidation or distribution, by change of control, or by operation of law, without Maker’s prior written consent, which may be withheld in Maker’s sole discretion. Any purported transfer without that consent shall be void and ineffective. Without limiting the foregoing, if Noteholder proposes or becomes obligated to make any such transfer, Noteholder shall first give Maker written notice describing the proposed transfer, the proposed transferee and the price and other terms, and Maker shall have the right, exercisable by written notice within fifteen (15) Business Days after receipt of such notice, to purchase this Note on the same terms (or, if the transfer is not for cash, for a cash price equal to the fair value of the consideration offered). If Maker does not exercise such right, any transfer shall remain subject to Maker’s prior written consent as provided above. Maker may assign this Note and its obligations without Noteholder’s consent to a successor to the Business or to a Senior Lender as a collateral assignment. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Noteholder may transfer this Note in whole, together with Noteholder’s rights under the Security Agreement, without Maker’s consent and free of Maker’s purchase right under this Section 10, to PSQ Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation, Credova Holdings, Inc., Credova Financial, LLC, Credova SPV I, LLC, Credova SPV IV, LLC, Credova Technology, LLC, PSQ Payments, LLC, PSQImpact, LLC, PublicSq. Inc., PSQAdvisors, LLC, PSQ Servicing, LLC, PSQ Fintech Holdings, LLC, PSQ MTL, LLC, and PSQ Link, LLC (each, a “ Permitted Transferee ”), provided that (a) Noteholder delivers to Maker written notice of such transfer at least ten (10) days before the transfer, identifying the Permitted Transferee and designating its payment account; (b) the Permitted Transferee is PSQ Holdings, Inc. or is, and at all times while it holds this Note remains, wholly owned, directly or indirectly, by PSQ Holdings, Inc.; (c) the Permitted Transferee agrees in a writing delivered to Maker to be bound by this Note (including Section 4), the Security Agreement and any subordination or intercreditor agreement delivered under Section 3; (d) the Permitted Transferee shall not pledge or make any collateral assignment of this Note; and (e) at the time of transfer, neither Noteholder nor the Permitted Transferee is the subject of any proceeding under bankruptcy law. Upon a transfer in compliance with this paragraph, (i) the Permitted Transferee shall be “Noteholder” for all purposes of this Note and the Security Agreement, and (ii) the account so designated shall be the Payment Account, which the Permitted Transferee alone may thereafter change in accordance with the introductory paragraph of this Note. Any other transfer remains subject to Maker’s prior written consent and purchase right as provided above. 11. Successors and Assigns . This Note shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of Maker and Noteholder and their respective successors and permitted assigns, subject to the transfer restrictions in Section 10. No person other than Noteholder, a Permitted Transferee, or a transferee approved in accordance with Section 10 may enforce or receive payment under this Note. 12. Governing Law; Choice of Forum . This Note and the Security Agreement, and all claims or causes of action arising out of or relating to this Note or the Security Agreement, shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without giving effect to conflict-of-law principles. Each party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Delaware Court of Chancery and the United States District Court for the District of Delaware, and, if federal subject matter jurisdiction is unavailable, the Delaware Court of Chancery, and waives any objection to venue or inconvenient forum. 6 13. Notice . All notices, requests, demands, and other communications required or permitted under this Note shall be in writing and shall be deemed duly given when sent by electronic transmission with confirmation of receipt, when delivered by courier, or five (5) Business Days after being deposited in the United States mail, certified or registered with receipt requested and postage prepaid, in each case addressed as follows (with copies to counsel, which copies shall not constitute notice): If to Maker: FreeHold Brands, LLC 4100 E. Parham Rd, Ste D Henrico, Virginia 23228 Attention: Evans Richards Email: [***] With a copy to: Sands Anderson PC 919 East Main Street, Suite 2300 Richmond, Virginia 23218-1998 Attention: Ashley Burgess Email: [***] If to Noteholder: EveryLife Inc. and EveryLife Women, LLC c/o PSQ Holdings, Inc. 515 W Aspen Street, Suite 200C Bozeman, Montana 59715 Attention: Chief Executive Officer Email: [***] With a copy to: Faegre Drinker Biddle & Reath LLP 1144 15th Street, Suite 3400 Denver, Colorado 80202 Attention: Jeffrey A. Sherman Email: [***] Any party may change its address or email address for purposes of this Section by written notice to the other party in accordance with this Section. 14. Severability . In the event that one or more of the provisions contained herein shall be invalid, illegal, or unenforceable in any respect for any reason, the validity, legality, and enforceability of any such provision in every other respect and of the remaining provisions of this Note shall not be in any way impaired and this Note shall be construed as if such invalid, illegal, or unenforceable provision had never been contained herein. 15. Entire Agreement; Modification . This Note, the Purchase Agreement, and the Related Agreements embody the entire agreement and understanding of the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersede prior agreements and understandings relating to that subject matter. This Note is expressly subject to the Purchase Agreement, and, in the event of any conflict or inconsistency between this Note and the Purchase Agreement, the Purchase Agreement shall govern and control. No change or modification of this Note shall be valid unless set forth in a writing signed by Maker and Noteholder. Nothing in this Note shall modify, expand, or limit any right, obligation, representation, warranty, covenant, indemnity, or remedy under the Purchase Agreement or any Related Agreement. 7 16. Limitations of Applicable Law . In the event the operation of any provision of this Note results in an effective rate of interest transcending the limit of the usury or any other law applicable to the loan evidenced hereby, the rate of interest under this Note shall be modified to comply with such laws. 17. Debtor-Creditor Relationship . Noteholder shall in no event be construed for any purpose to be a partner, joint venturer, or associate of Maker as a result of the terms of this Note, it being the sole intention of the parties to establish a relationship of debtor and creditor hereunder. 18. Cancellation; Release of Lien . Upon payment or other satisfaction (including by setoff in accordance with Section 4, it being understood that any amount withheld under clause (b) of Section 4 shall constitute satisfaction only when finally determined to be owed) of all amounts owed under this Note, this Note shall be deemed paid in full and cancelled, Noteholder shall promptly mark this Note “paid” and return it to Maker, and Noteholder shall, within five (5) Business Days, terminate its security interest in the Collateral and file, or authorize Maker to file, UCC termination statements and any other release documents reasonably requested by Maker. [signature page follows] 8 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Maker has executed this Note as of the date first written above. PO Box 309, Ugland House, Grand Cayman, KY1-1104, Cayman Islands October 30, 2026 This Settlement Agreement (this “ Settlement Agreement ”) is being executed by and between Sea Otter Trading, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the “ Investor ”), and Aeries Technology, Inc., a Cayman Islands exempted company (formerly known as Worldwide Webb Acquisition Corp.) (the “ Company ,” and together with the Investor, the “ Parties ” and each, a “ Party ”). Reference is made to that certain Confirmation of OTC Equity Prepaid Forward Transaction, dated as of November 3, 2023, by and between the Company and the Investor, as amended by that certain Forward Purchase Agreement Confirmation Amendment, dated as of November 3, 2023, as amended and restated (as amended and restated, the “ Agreement ”, collectively with all other instruments, agreements or other items executed or delivered in connection with the Agreement or between the Parties in contemplation of the consummation of the de-SPAC transaction of the Company completed in November 2023, are referred to herein as the “ Transaction Documents ”). Reference is also made to that certain Letter Agreement, dated as of August 3, 2026, by and between the Investor and the Company (the “ Letter Agreement ”). WHEREAS , pursuant to the Agreement, the Company was obligated to pay the Investor the Maturity Consideration (as defined in the Agreement), consisting of a cash payment equal to $911,461 (the “Payment Liability”), as of the Maturity Date (as defined in the Agreement); WHEREAS , the Parties entered into the Letter Agreement to provide for the settlement of the Payment Liability through periodic amortization payments, the issuance of 145,183 Class A ordinary shares of the Company (the “ Shares ”) as collateral, and certain related sale mechanics and covenants; WHEREAS , the Parties now desire to settle and resolve all outstanding obligations under the Agreement, the Transaction Documents, and the Letter Agreement on the terms set forth herein; and WHEREAS , in connection with such settlement, the Company desires to make a lump-sum cash payment to the Investor, and the Investor desires to return all Shares to the Company, all on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth herein. NOW, THEREFORE , in exchange for good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged and confirmed, and in consideration of the mutual promises, covenants and agreements set forth herein, and intending to be legally bound hereby, the Parties hereby agree as follows: 1. Escrow Agreement . (a) Concurrently with the execution of this Settlement Agreement, the Company and the Investor shall enter into an escrow agreement with Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company, as escrow agent (the “ Escrow Agent ”), substantially in the form attached hereto as Annexure A (the “ Escrow Agreement ”), pursuant to which the Escrow Agent shall establish a segregated, non-interest-bearing escrow account (the “ Escrow Account ”). (b) The Escrow Agreement shall provide, among other things, that: (i) the Escrow Agent shall hold the Settlement Payment (as defined in Section 2) in the Escrow Account and shall disburse it only as set forth in this Section 1(b); (ii) upon receipt by the Escrow Agent of written confirmation from the Transfer Agent (as defined in Section 3(a)) that all 145,183 Shares have been transferred to the Company in accordance with Section 3(a) (the “ Share Transfer Confirmation ”), the Escrow Agent shall promptly, without any further act, consent or instruction of either Party, release the Settlement Payment to the Investor by wire transfer to the account designated by the Investor in the Escrow Agreement; (iii) if the Escrow Agent has not received the Share Transfer Confirmation within 10 business days from the date of this agreement (or such later date as the Parties may jointly instruct the Escrow Agent in writing) (the “ Outside Date ”), the Escrow Agent shall return the Settlement Payment to the Company; and (iv) all fees and charges of the Escrow Agent shall be borne by the Company. (c) Each Party shall deliver such joint written instructions and take such other actions as may be required under the Escrow Agreement to give effect to this Section 1, and neither Party shall deliver any instruction to the Escrow Agent that is inconsistent with this Section 1. (d) If the Settlement Payment is returned to the Company in accordance with Section 1(b)(iii), the releases set forth in Section 4 and the termination set forth in Section 5 shall not become effective. (e) The release of the Settlement Payment to the Investor from the Escrow Account in accordance with the Escrow Agreement shall constitute payment in full of the Settlement Payment and full satisfaction of the Company’s payment obligations under this Settlement Agreement, and the Company shall have no liability for any act or omission of the Escrow Agent. As between the Parties, in the event of any conflict between this Settlement Agreement and the Escrow Agreement, this Settlement Agreement shall prevail. 2. Settlement Payment . Following the execution of the Escrow Agreement, the Company shall deposit a cash amount equal to $911,461 (the “ Settlement Payment ”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds into the Escrow Account, in accordance with the Escrow Agreement. 3. Return of Shares . (a) Upon written confirmation by the Escrow Agent to the Parties, pursuant to the Escrow Agreement, of its receipt of the Settlement Payment in the Escrow Account, the Investor shall, within two (2) business days thereafter, return to the Company all 145,183 Shares held by the Investor. The Investor shall execute and deliver all instruments and take all actions as may be reasonably requested by the Company to effectuate such return of Shares, including, without limitation, the delivery of executed stock transfer powers bearing a medallion signature guarantee and any other customary transfer documentation required by Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company, in its capacity as transfer agent of the Company (the “ Transfer Agent ”). (b) The Investor represents and warrants to the Company that (i) it is the sole record and beneficial owner of all 145,183 Shares, free and clear of any lien, pledge, security interest, encumbrance, claim or other restriction (other than restrictions under applicable securities laws); (ii) it has not sold, transferred, assigned, pledged or otherwise disposed of any of the Shares or any interest therein; and (iii) upon the transfer of the Shares in accordance with Section 3(a), the Company will acquire good and valid title to all of the Shares, free and clear of any such lien, pledge, security interest, encumbrance, claim or restriction. Pending such transfer, the Investor shall not sell, transfer, assign, pledge or otherwise dispose of any of the Shares or any interest therein. 4. Mutual General Releases . (a) Effective automatically as of the Release Effective Date (as defined in Section 4(e)), and for and in consideration of the covenants and agreements set forth herein, each Party, on behalf of itself and its past, present and future affiliates, parents, subsidiaries, predecessors, successors and assigns, and each of their respective past, present and future officers, directors, managers, members, partners, principals, owners, shareholders, employees, attorneys, insurers, reinsurers, agents, representatives, heirs, executors, administrators, successors-in-interest and predecessors-in-interest, whether in their individual or official capacities (collectively, the “ Releasing Parties ”), hereby irrevocably and unconditionally releases, acquits and forever discharges the other Party and such other Party’s past, present and future affiliates, parents, subsidiaries, predecessors, successors and assigns, and each of their respective past, present and future officers, directors, managers, members, partners, principals, owners, shareholders, employees, attorneys, insurers, reinsurers, agents, representatives, heirs, executors, administrators, successors-in-interest and predecessors-in-interest, whether in their individual or official capacities (collectively, the 2 “ Released Parties ”) from any and all claims, demands, actions, causes of action, suits, debts, dues, sums of money, accounts, reckonings, bonds, bills, specialties, covenants, contracts, controversies, agreements, promises, variances, trespasses, damages, judgments, extents, executions, obligations, liabilities, losses, costs and expenses (including, without limitation, reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs), of every kind and nature whatsoever, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, disclosed or undisclosed, matured or unmatured, accrued or unaccrued, fixed or contingent, whether arising at law, in equity or otherwise, which the Releasing Parties now have, have ever had, or may hereafter have against the Released Parties, for, upon or by reason of any matter, cause or thing whatsoever from the beginning of time through and including the Release Effective Date, including, without limitation, any claims arising out of, relating to, or in connection with the Agreement, the Transaction Documents, the Letter Agreement, the Shares, the Payment Liability, or any other dealings, negotiations, transactions or arrangements between the Parties, including in connection with the de-SPAC transaction of the Company (collectively, the “ Released Claims ”). (b) Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Released Claims shall not include any claims arising out of or relating to the enforcement of the terms and conditions of this Settlement Agreement or the Escrow Agreement, or any breach thereof. (c) Each Party represents and warrants that it has not heretofore assigned, transferred or granted, or purported to assign, transfer or grant, any of the Released Claims or any part thereof to any other person or entity. Each Party, on behalf of itself and the other Releasing Parties, covenants not to commence, maintain, prosecute or voluntarily assist in any action, suit or proceeding against any Released Party with respect to any Released Claim. (d) Each Party acknowledges that it may hereafter discover facts in addition to or different from those that it now knows or believes to be true with respect to the Released Claims, and agrees that this release shall be and remain in full force and effect in all respects notwithstanding such additional or different facts or the discovery thereof. Each Party expressly waives, to the fullest extent permitted by law, the benefit of Section 1542 of the California Civil Code and of any other statute, rule or doctrine of any jurisdiction that would otherwise limit the release of unknown or unsuspected claims. (e) Until both (i) the Settlement Payment has been released to the Investor from the Escrow Account in accordance with Section 1 and the Escrow Agreement and (ii) the Investor has transferred all 145,183 Shares to the Company as provided in Section 3(a), the releases set forth in this Section 4 shall have no force or effect, and neither Party shall be deemed to have released any Released Claims. Upon the satisfaction of both conditions (the date on which both such conditions are satisfied, the “ Release Effective Date ”), the releases shall become effective automatically without any further action by either Party. 5. Termination of Prior Agreements . Effective upon the Release Effective Date, the Agreement, the Transaction Documents and the Letter Agreement are hereby terminated in their entirety and shall be of no further force or effect, and all rights and obligations of the Parties thereunder (other than any provisions that by their nature are intended to survive termination, including, without limitation, any confidentiality obligations contained therein) shall cease and be extinguished. Upon the Release Effective Date, this Settlement Agreement shall supersede and replace the Letter Agreement in its entirety. For the avoidance of doubt, from and after the Release Effective Date, neither Party shall have any further rights, obligations or liabilities under the Agreement, the Transaction Documents or the Letter Agreement, except as expressly set forth in this Settlement Agreement. From the date of this Settlement Agreement until the earlier of the Release Effective Date and the Outside Date, neither Party shall take any action to enforce any right or remedy under, and no payment shall become due from the Company under, the Agreement, the Transaction Documents or the Letter Agreement. 3 6. No Admission of Liability . This Settlement Agreement constitutes a compromise and settlement of disputed matters and shall not be construed as an admission of liability or wrongdoing by either Party. Each Party expressly denies any liability to the other Party in connection with the matters resolved herein. 7. Governing Law; Jurisdiction . This Settlement Agreement shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the State of New York, without giving effect to any choice or conflict of law provision or rule (whether of the State of New York or any other jurisdiction) that would cause the application of the laws of any jurisdiction other than the State of New York. Each Party irrevocably and unconditionally submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the federal and state courts located in the State of New York, County of New York, for the purpose of any suit, action or other proceeding arising out of or based upon this Settlement Agreement or the transactions contemplated hereby, and each Party irrevocably waives and agrees not to assert, by way of motion, as a defense, counterclaim or otherwise, any claim that it is not subject personally to the jurisdiction of such courts, that its property is exempt or immune from attachment or execution, that any such suit, action or proceeding is brought in an inconvenient forum, that the venue of any such suit, action or proceeding is improper, or that this Settlement Agreement or the subject matter hereof may not be enforced in or by such courts. 8. Entire Agreement . This Settlement Agreement, together with the Escrow Agreement, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, warranties, commitments, offers, contracts and agreements, whether written or oral, relating to such subject matter. 9. Amendments; Waivers . No amendment, modification or waiver of any provision of this Settlement Agreement shall be effective or enforceable unless made in a writing signed by each of the Parties. No waiver of any provision of this Settlement Agreement shall operate or be construed as a waiver of any other provision, whether or not similar, nor shall any waiver constitute a continuing waiver. The failure or delay of either Party in exercising any right, power or privilege under this Settlement Agreement shall not operate as a waiver thereof. 10. Severability . If any term, provision, covenant or restriction of this Settlement Agreement is held by a court of competent jurisdiction to be invalid, illegal, void or unenforceable, the remainder of the terms, provisions, covenants and restrictions set forth herein shall remain in full force and effect and shall in no way be affected, impaired or invalidated, and the Parties shall use their commercially reasonable efforts to find and employ an alternative means to achieve the same or substantially the same result as that contemplated by such term, provision, covenant or restriction. 11. Attorneys’ Fees . In the event that any legal action or proceeding is initiated by either Party to enforce or interpret any provision of this Settlement Agreement, or to resolve any dispute arising out of or related to this Settlement Agreement, the prevailing party in such action or proceeding shall be entitled to recover its reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs, including fees and costs on any appeals, in addition to any other relief to which such prevailing party may be entitled. 12. Notices . All notices, requests, demands and other communications under this Settlement Agreement shall be in writing and shall be deemed to have been duly given (a) when delivered personally, (b) when sent by e-mail (with a copy sent by nationally recognized overnight courier), (c) one business day after being sent by nationally recognized overnight courier, or (d) three business days after being deposited in the United States mail, certified or registered, postage prepaid, return receipt requested, addressed as follows: If to the Investor: If to the Company: Sea Otter Trading, LLC 1111 Brickell Ave, Suite 2920 Miami FL, 33131 Aeries Technology, Inc. PO Box 309, Ugland House, Grand Cayman, KY1-1104, Cayman Islands *** *** Attention: Peter Smith Attention: Ajay Khare, CEO or to such other address or email-address as either Party may designate in writing from time to time in accordance with this Section 12. 4 13. Counterparts . This Settlement Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which, when so executed, shall be deemed an original, but all such counterparts, taken together, shall constitute one and the same instrument. Delivery of an executed counterpart of a signature page of this Settlement Agreement by facsimile or other electronic means (including portable document format (.pdf)) shall be equally as effective as delivery of a manually executed counterpart of this Settlement Agreement. 14. Authority; Acknowledgement . Each Party represents and warrants that it has read this Settlement Agreement, understands its terms and conditions, has had the opportunity to consult with counsel of its choosing, and enters into it knowingly and voluntarily. Each signatory to this Settlement Agreement represents and warrants that such person is duly authorized and empowered to execute this Settlement Agreement on behalf of the Party for which such person is signing, and that upon execution this Settlement Agreement will be legally binding upon such Party without any further approval, ratification or other action. [Signature pages follow] 5 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have executed this Settlement Agreement as of the date first written above. SEA OTTER TRADING, LLC AERIES TECHNOLOGY, INC. By: /s/ Peter Smith By: /s/ Ajay Khare Name: Peter Smith Name: Ajay Khare Title: Authorized Representative Title: Chief Executive Officer 6 ANNEXURE A FORM OF ESCROW AGREEMENT ESCROW AGREEMENT This ESCROW AGREEMENT (this “ Agreement ”) made as of October __, 2026 by and among Aeries Technology, Inc., a Cayman Islands exempted company (the “ Company ”), Sea Otter Trading, LLC , a Delaware limited liability company (the “Party ”) and Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company, 1 State Street, New York, NY 10004 (the “ Escrow Agent ”). WITNESSETH : WHEREAS , pursuant to the Settlement Agreement, dated as of [●], 2026, between the Company and the Party (the “Settlement Agreement”), the Company is in the process of receiving 145,183 Class A ordinary shares of the Company (the “Shares”) from the Party, as set forth opposite its name on Exhibit A , for an aggregate cash payment of $961,461 (the “ Escrow Amounts ”) in full settlement of the amounts outstanding under the Confirmation of OTC Equity Prepaid Forward Transaction, dated as of November 3, 2023, between the Company and the Party (as amended), and the Letter Agreement, dated as of August 3, 2026, between the Company and the Party (the “Letter Agreement”); WHEREAS , prior to the closing of the foregoing transaction, the Company has agreed to deposit the Escrow Amounts into the escrow account established with the Escrow Agent (the “ Escrow Account ”); WHEREAS , the Company and the Party wish to engage the Escrow Agent to act, and the Escrow Agent is willing to act in that capacity, to hold and administer and distribute the amounts deposited into the Escrow Account hereunder in accordance with, and subject to, the terms of this Agreement. NOW, THEREFORE , in consideration of the premises and mutual covenants herein contained, the parties hereto hereby agree as follows: 1. Information Sheet . The recitals to this Agreement and the information set forth on the information sheet which is attached to this Agreement as Exhibit B (the “ Information Sheet ”) are incorporated by reference herein and made a part hereof. 2. Establishment of the Escrow Account . 2.1 The Escrow Agent is hereby appointed as escrow agent to hold and distribute the Escrow Amounts in accordance with the terms hereof, and the Escrow Agent hereby accepts such appointment and agrees to act in such capacity in accordance with the terms hereof. 2.2 The Escrow Agent shall establish a separate non-interest-bearing bank account at JPMorgan Chase Bank (the “ Bank Account ”) and bearing the designation set forth on Section 1 of the Information Sheet for the benefit of the Company and the Party pursuant to this Agreement, and shall not commingle the Escrow Amounts with any other third-party deposits or its own funds. While the Escrow Amounts are on deposit, the Escrow Agent may earn bank credits or other consideration. The Escrow Agent shall advise the Party and the Company with respect to the account number of the Bank Account and the wire transfer instructions with respect thereto. 2.3 The Escrow Agent shall maintain a separate record of the amount held at any time, and transactions effected into or from, the Escrow Account. 7 3. Deposits to the Bank Account . 3.1 The Company shall notify the Escrow Agent with respect to the deposit of the Escrow Amounts into the Bank Account. The Escrow Agent shall cause the Bank to process such Escrow Amounts for collection through the banking system. 3.2 The Escrow Agent shall not be required to accept in the Escrow Account any amounts representing payments by the parties, except during the Escrow Agent’s regular business hours. 3.3 Only the Escrow Amounts which have been deposited in the Bank Account, and which have cleared the banking system and have been collected by the Escrow Agent, are herein referred to as the “ Funds .” 3.4 The Escrow Agent shall provide written confirmation to the Company and the Party of its receipt of the Escrow Amounts immediately upon their deposit with the Escrow Agent. 4. Disbursement from the Escrow Account . 4.1 Upon the receipt of written confirmation from Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company, in its capacity as transfer agent of the Company, that all 145,183 Shares have been transferred from the Party to the Company (the “ Share Transfer Confirmation ”), promptly thereafter, the Escrow Agent shall, without any further act, consent or instruction of the Company or the Party, disburse the Funds to the Party in accordance with the wire transfer instructions set forth in Exhibit A hereto. 4.2 In the event the Escrow Agent has not received the Share Transfer Confirmation within 10 business days from the days of Settlement agreement (or such later date as the Company and the Party may jointly instruct the Escrow Agent in writing) (the “Outside Date”), the Escrow Agent shall as promptly thereafter as practicable return the Escrow Amounts to the Company in accordance with the wire transfer instructions set forth in Exhibit A-1 hereto. 4.3 Upon disbursement of the Funds pursuant to the terms of this Section 4 , the Escrow Agent shall be relieved of further obligations and released from all liability under this Agreement. It is expressly agreed and understood that in no event shall the aggregate amount of payments required to be made by the Escrow Agent exceed the amount of the Funds. 5. Rights, Duties and Responsibilities of Escrow Agent . It is understood and agreed that the duties of the Escrow Agent are purely ministerial in nature, and that: 5.1 The Escrow Agent shall notify the Company and the Party, on a daily basis, of the Escrow Amounts which have been deposited in the Escrow Account and of the amounts, constituting the Funds, which have cleared the banking system and have been collected by the Escrow Agent, and all other Funds. 5.2 The Escrow Agent shall not be responsible for or be required to enforce any of the terms or conditions of any agreement between the Company and the Party nor shall the Escrow Agent be responsible for the performance by the Company or the Party of their respective obligations under this Agreement. 5.3 The Escrow Agent shall be entitled to rely upon the accuracy, act in reliance upon the contents, and assume the genuineness of any notice, instruction, certificate, signature, instrument or other document which is given to the Escrow Agent by the Company and the Party pursuant to this Agreement without the necessity of the Escrow Agent verifying the truth or accuracy thereof. The Escrow Agent shall not be obligated to make any inquiry as to the authority, capacity, existence, or identity of any person purporting to give any such notice or instructions or to execute any such certificate, instrument, or other document. 8 5.4 If the Escrow Agent is uncertain as to its duties or rights hereunder or shall receive instructions with respect to the Escrow Account, the Escrow Amounts or the Funds which, in its sole determination, are in conflict either with other instructions received by it or with any provision of this Agreement, it shall be entitled to hold the Escrow Amounts, the Funds, or a portion thereof, in the Escrow Account pending the resolution of such uncertainty to the Escrow Agent’s sole satisfaction, by final judgment of a court or courts of competent jurisdiction or otherwise. 5.5 The Escrow Agent shall not be liable for any action taken or omitted hereunder, or for the misconduct of any employee, agent or attorney appointed by it, except in the case of willful misconduct or gross negligence. The Escrow Agent shall be entitled to consult with counsel of its own choosing and shall not be liable for any action taken, suffered, or omitted by it in accordance with the advice of such counsel. 5.6 The Escrow Agent shall have no responsibility at any time to ascertain whether or not any security interest exists in the Escrow Amounts, the Funds, or any part thereof or to file any financing statement under the Uniform Commercial Code with respect to the Funds or any part thereof. 6. Amendment; Resignation or Removal of Escrow Agent . This Agreement may not be altered or amended without the prior the written consent of Company, the Party, and the Escrow Agent. The Escrow Agent may resign and be discharged from its duties hereunder at any time by giving written notice of such resignation to the Company and the Party specifying a date when such resignation shall take effect and upon delivery of the Funds to the successor escrow agent designated by the Company and the Party in writing. Such successor Escrow Agent shall become the Escrow Agent hereunder upon the resignation date specified in such notice. If the Company and the Party fail to designate a successor Escrow Agent within thirty (30) days after such notice, then the resigning Escrow Agent shall promptly return the Funds to the Company in accordance with the wire transfer instructions set forth in Exhibit A-1 , without interest thereon or deduction by the Escrow Agent. The Escrow Agent shall continue to serve until its successor accepts the escrow and receives the Funds. The Company and the Party shall have the right at any time to remove the Escrow Agent and substitute a new escrow agent by giving notice thereof to the Escrow Agent then acting. Upon its resignation and delivery of the Funds as set forth in this Section 6 , the Escrow Agent shall be discharged of and from any and all further obligations arising in connection with the escrow contemplated by this Agreement. Without limiting the provisions of Section 8 hereof, the resigning Escrow Agent shall be entitled to be reimbursed by the Company and Party for any expenses incurred in connection with its resignation, transfer of the Funds to a successor escrow agent or distribution of the Funds pursuant to this Section 6 . 7. Representations and Warranties . The Company and Party hereby represent and warrant, severally and jointly, to the Escrow Agent that: 7.1 No party other than the parties hereto have, or shall have, any lien, claim or security interest in the Escrow Amounts or the Funds, or any part thereof. 7.2 No financing statement under the Uniform Commercial Code is on file in any jurisdiction claiming a security interest in or describing (whether specifically or generally) the Escrow Amounts or the Funds or any part thereof. 7.3 All of the information with respect to the parties contained in the Information Sheet is, as of the date hereof, and will be, at the time of any disbursement of the Funds, true and correct. 7.4 Reasonable controls have been established and required due diligence performed to comply with “Know Your Customer” regulations, USA Patriot Act, Office of Foreign Asset Control (OFAC) regulations and the Bank Secrecy Act. 9 8. Fees and Expenses . The Company shall be responsible for the payment of the Escrow Agent Fees set forth on the Information Sheet, payable as and when stated therein. In addition, the Company agrees to reimburse the Escrow Agent for any reasonable expenses incurred in connection with this Agreement, including, but not limited to, reasonable counsel fees. 9. Indemnification and Contribution . 9.1 The Company and the Party (referred to as the “Indemnitors”) jointly and severally agree to indemnify the Escrow Agent and its officers, directors, employees, agents and shareholders (collectively referred to as the “Indemnitees”) against, and hold them harmless of and from, any and all direct loss, liability, cost, damage and expense, including without limitation, reasonable counsel fees, which the Indemnitees may suffer or incur by reason of any action, claim or proceeding brought against the Indemnitees arising out of or relating in any way to this Agreement or any transaction to which this Agreement relates, unless such action, claim or proceeding is the result of the willful misconduct, fraud or gross negligence of the Indemnitees. 9.2 If the indemnification provided for in Section 9.1 is applicable, but for any reason is held to be unavailable, the Indemnitors shall contribute such amounts as are just and equitable to pay, or to reimburse the Indemnitees for, the aggregate of any and all losses, liabilities, costs, damages and expenses, including counsel fees, actually incurred by the Indemnitees as a result of or in connection with, and any amount paid in settlement of, any action, claim or proceeding arising out of or relating in any way to any actions or omissions of the Indemnitors. 9.3 The provisions of this Section 9 shall survive any termination of this Agreement, whether by disbursement of the Fund, resignation of the Escrow Agent or otherwise. 10. Termination of Agreement . This Agreement shall terminate on the final disposition of the Funds pursuant to Section 4 , provided that the rights of the Escrow Agent and the obligations of the other parties hereto under Section 9 shall survive the termination hereof and the resignation or removal of the Escrow Agent. 11. Governing Law and Assignment . This Agreement shall be construed in accordance with and governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to the conflicts of laws principles thereof, and shall be binding, upon the parties hereto and their respective successors and assigns; provided, however , that any assignment or transfer by any party of its rights under this Agreement or with respect to the Escrow Amounts or the Funds shall be void as against the Escrow Agent unless (a) written notice thereof shall be given to the Escrow Agent; and (b) the Escrow Agent shall have consented in writing to such assignment or transfer. 12. Notices . All notices required to be given in connection with this Agreement shall be sent by registered or certified mail, return receipt requested, or by hand delivery with receipt acknowledged, or by the Express Mail service offered by the United States Postal Service, and addressed as follows: If to the Escrow Agent : Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company Escrow Department 1 State Street, 30th Floor New York, New York 10004 Attention: Jaswinder Goraya / Matthew Velazquez Email: *** *** 10 If to the Company : Name: Salma Curmally Title: Director – Legal & Compliance Entity: Aeries Technology, Inc. Address: 5th Floor, Paville House, Twin Tower Lane, Prabhadevi, Mumbai, MH, India 400025 Email: *** If to the Party : Name: Peter Smith Title: Authorized Representative Entity: Sea Otter Trading, LLC Address: 1111 Brickell Ave, Suite 2920, Miami FL, 33131 Email: *** 13. Third Party Beneficiaries . No persons or entities are intended to be third party beneficiaries of the escrow arrangements contemplated by this Agreement. 14. Severability . If any provision of this Agreement or the application thereof to any person or circumstance shall be determined to be invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions of this Agreement or the application of such provision to persons or circumstances other than those to which it is held invalid or unenforceable shall not be affected thereby and shall be valid and enforceable to the fullest extent permitted by law. 15. Execution in Several Counterparts . This Agreement may be executed in several counterparts or by separate instruments and by facsimile transmission or by electronic mail in “portable document format” (“.pdf”) and all of such counterparts and instruments shall constitute one agreement, binding on all of the parties hereto. 16. Entire Agreement . This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties hereto with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior agreements and understandings (written or oral) of the parties in connection therewith. [Signature page follows] 11 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have caused this Escrow Agreement to be duly executed as of the date and year first written above.
